name: web-black-and-magenta-saas-finance-site-template-preview
title: Black finance SaaS template with a magenta glow behind a dashboard, logo pills and workflow cards on a dusty mauve board
whatItIs: A mauve board with 'LIVE PREVIEW SaaS & Tech Website' and a black page: a pill nav, a headline 'Enhance your financial control with Nexio' with a decorated pill label, a dashboard preview glowing with a magenta-to-pink gradient, a row of pill-shaped logos, a section 'How our platform makes your workflow easier' and dashboard cards.
whatItMeans: Sleek and premium; a magenta glow lifts a black dashboard without adding clutter.
techniques: Glow a gradient behind the dashboard.
Use decorated label pills with small lines and diamonds.

vocabulary.definition: A coloured bloom behind a UI preview.
A pill flanked by small lines and dots.
An overview of a website template.
